skill.name: expensesnap
skill.description: Organize manually entered project time and business expenses into reviewable summaries and export-ready records for freelancers and microbusinesses.
skill.summary: Summarize manually entered project time and expenses with validation, estimated totals, and export-ready records.
skill.author: falconprojectai-arch

security_audit.summary: There are no static findings to adjudicate. The reviewed prompt describes manual record validation and summary generation, with explicit limits on invoicing, taxes, payments, and reconciliation. No evidence found of prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, or executable behavior in the supplied skill.

content.user_title: Organize Project Time and Business Expenses
content.value_statement: Manual time and expense records can be incomplete and difficult to review by project. ExpenseSnap organizes supplied entries, checks basic fields, and prepares estimated totals with export-ready records.
actual_capabilities: Request project labels, dates, entry types, descriptions, quantities, rates or amounts, and currencies.
Check dates, numeric quantities, non-negative amounts, and currency consistency.
Calculate time totals from hours and hourly rates, and expense totals from entered amounts.
Group entries by project and period while separating billable time from expenses.
Prepare tables or CSV/JSON structures and flag missing information.
Label totals as estimates based only on supplied records.
limitations: Does not issue legal invoices, determine tax treatment, collect payments, or reconcile bank or accounting records.
Depends on manually supplied records and does not independently verify transactions.
Includes prompt instructions only; the referenced companion browser tool is not included in the supplied skill.
The described companion tool lacks cloud backup, collaboration, accounting sync, automatic timers, and payment processing.

use_cases.title: Review Freelance Project Totals
use_cases.description: Combine manually entered hours and project expenses into a period summary before preparing billing documents separately.

use_cases.title: Prepare Business Expense Records
use_cases.description: Group supplied business expenses by project and reporting period, with missing fields flagged for correction.

use_cases.title: Check Records Before Handoff
use_cases.description: Review dates, currencies, and amounts before handing export-ready records to an accountant for further processing.

prompt_templates.title: Enter a First Record
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me record one project expense. Ask for the required fields, validate my answers, and show a reviewable table.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize Project Time
prompt_templates.prompt: Summarize these time entries for [project] during [period]: [entries]. Check dates, hours, rates, and currencies, then calculate estimated totals.
prompt_templates.scenario: Basic: calculate a project time summary.

prompt_templates.title: Review Mixed Entries
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these time and expense records: [records]. Group them by project and month, separate billable time from expenses, and flag missing fields.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Validated Export Records
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare CSV records from [entries] for [period]. Validate required fields and currency consistency. Flag unresolved entries without inventing values or converting currencies. Label totals as estimates.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: prepare export records with unresolved data identified.

output_examples.input: Project Atlas, November 5, 2026: 3 billable hours at 80 USD per hour and a 25 USD materials expense.
output: Billable time: 3 hours at 80 USD per hour = 240 USD.
Combined estimated total: 265 USD, based only on supplied records.

output_examples.input: Project Cedar, November 6, 2026: 2 hours of work with no rate, plus a 40 travel expense with no currency.
output: Time entry: missing hourly rate and currency.
Estimated monetary totals cannot be calculated until the missing fields are supplied.

best_practices: Provide a project label, date, description, quantity, rate or amount, and currency for each entry.
Review flagged fields and currency consistency before using estimated totals or exporting records.
Back up exports before clearing browser data when using the companion browser tool.
anti_patterns: Treating estimated summaries as legal invoices or tax determinations.
Combining different currencies into one total without resolving currency differences.
Assuming the skill provides bank reconciliation, automatic timers, or persistent cloud storage.

faq.question: What information does each entry need?
faq.answer: Provide the project or client, date, entry type, description, quantity, rate or amount, and currency.

faq.question: How are time totals calculated?
faq.answer: Time totals use hours multiplied by the hourly rate. Expense totals use entered amounts. All totals are estimates based on supplied records.

faq.question: Can ExpenseSnap issue invoices or calculate taxes?
faq.answer: No. The skill excludes legal invoice issuance, tax treatment, payment collection, and bank or accounting reconciliation.

faq.question: Which output formats are described?
faq.answer: The workflow supports reviewable tables and export-ready CSV or JSON structures, with missing information flagged.

faq.question: Does this skill include a browser application?
faq.answer: No. The supplied package contains only prompt instructions. It references a companion browser tool, but does not include that tool.

faq.question: Does the companion tool back up records automatically?
faq.answer: The skill describes local browser storage without cloud backup. Back up exported records before clearing browser data.
